answer_1.quote: Users can harness LLM-backed AI assistants for various subjective everyday tasks, which we define as self-contained activities that are straightforward for a user to describe to an AI assistant and involve the (anthropomorphized) AI assistant making some decision in completing the task.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to prompts for everyday tasks, such as summarizing articles, suggesting recipes, grouping students, writing code, and editing text
